text:
sophie: Hey team — PR #1873 updates retention wording and adds cURL + Python snippet for audit export, but legal suggested changing 'permanently stored' phrasing. Can someone help reword and fix the Ruby snippet? https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1873 :wave:

alex: I can take Ruby. quick Q: do we keep 30d TTL example or make it 90d?

legal-ops: Suggest 'retained for up to 90 days for audit purposes' instead of 'permanently'. Also call out pseudonymization requirements for exported identifiers. Ping @jordan for the data-flow diagram update.

jordan: I'll update the data-flow diagram and the curl example to include ?include_pseudonymized=true param. pushing a commit to the PR in a bit.

liam: docs review: the SDK snippet for Go uses v1beta path; should use v1. I'll submit a small patch for that snippet.

docsguild: heads-up: we should add a short callout about export encryption using standard language from the compliance playbook. Proposed text:

```text
Note: exported audit logs are encrypted at rest and in transit. Customers can choose Redwood-managed KMS keys or supply their own.
```

legal-ops: LGTM. Make sure to include retention TTL sample: `ttl_days: 90` and mention exceptions for legal hold and subpoena.

sophie: thanks all. @alex @liam @jordan can you comment on the PR when you push commits? I'll merge after legal signs off and CI green :white_check_mark:

alex: pushing Ruby fix now — changed wording to 'retained for up to 90 days for routine audits; customer data subject to legal hold exceptions.' Also updated the Ruby curl example to use the export endpoint example shown in the playbook.

jordan: pushed diagram + curl tweak. PR updated.

liam: PR: replaced v1beta with v1 in Go snippet and fixed import path.

docsguild: small nit — added canonical link to the compliance playbook at /docs/compliance/evidence-playbook.md and updated cross-links.

deploy-bot: checks/ci-docs: success — 7 checks passed.

sophie: merging now. Thanks folks :tada:
